Temporal Held-Out Validation

Source: R/profile_validate_holdout_tasks.R
profile_validate_temporal.Rd

Trains on events before cutoff_date and predicts events on or after it, with NOTHING known about the held-out event's AST results (the "unconditional" estimand) – the SAME prediction and scoring mechanics as profile_validate_newpatient, just a date-based split instead of a patient-based one. Reports the training/ holdout patient-overlap count explicitly when patient_id is supplied, rather than assuming temporal and patient independence.

Usage

profile_validate_temporal(
  Y,
  X,
  ids,
  event_date,
  cutoff_date,
  patient_id = NULL,
  output_dir,
  sampler_config = list(),
  n_draws = 500L,
  seed = 123L
)

Arguments

Y, X, ids

Same as profile_validate_heldout.

event_date

Date vector (or coercible via as.Date), length nrow(Y), in the SAME row order as Y/ids.

cutoff_date

Date (or coercible). Events with event_date < cutoff_date train; >= cutoff_date are held out.

patient_id

Character/integer vector or NULL. When supplied, the returned patient_overlap documents how many holdout-period patients also appear in the training period – temporal validation is not automatically patient-independent. Default NULL (no overlap report).

output_dir

Character. Passed to profile_fit_joint_bernoulli for the training-only refit.

sampler_config

Named list. Passed to profile_fit_joint_bernoulli for the training-only refit.

n_draws, seed

Passed to profile_estimate.

Value

Named list: predictions, summary, calibration, refit_result, n_holdout_events, n_train_events, cutoff_date (echoed), and patient_overlap (list: n_overlapping_patients, fraction_of_holdout_patients – both NA when patient_id is not supplied).
